subject.title: TUI: Add config support for --deliver flag default

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent TUI delivery default, and should the canonical surface be `tui.deliver`, an in-TUI persisted setting, or a changed CLI default with explicit opt-out?
rationale: The missing capability is clear from source, but repository policy sets a high bar for new config/default surfaces and outbound delivery defaults affect existing operator expectations.

options.title: Add persistent TUI default
options.body: Add the chosen default surface with schema/help/docs/tests and make explicit CLI flags override the persisted preference.

options.title: Keep delivery transient
options.body: Leave delivery as an explicit per-session launch or runtime choice and document that no persisted default is planned.

options.title: Change CLI default
options.body: Make delivery on by default only if maintainers accept the compatibility and outbound-delivery behavior change.

recommendation.title: Add persistent TUI default
recommendation.body: Add the chosen default surface with schema/help/docs/tests and make explicit CLI flags override the persisted preference.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant TUI/config surface and product-default decision trace most strongly to steipete in current history.
